quests.correctAnswer: She washes her hands before every meal.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Then the action and object. Then before+noun phrase.
quests.explanation: 'Before every meal' - 'before'+noun phrase shows regular sequence.

quests.correctAnswer: He leaves the office at five o'clock.
quests.hint: Begin with 'He'. Then action, place, exact time.
quests.explanation: 'At five o'clock' uses 'at' with specific times.

quests.correctAnswer: The baker wakes up at four in the morning.
quests.hint: Start with 'The baker'. Then action, early time.
quests.explanation: 'At four in the morning'=4:00 AM.

quests.correctAnswer: My father repairs old clocks as a hobby.
quests.hint: Begin with 'My father'. Then action, object, as phrase.
quests.explanation: 'As a hobby'='as' shows the category of an activity.

quests.correctAnswer: She keeps a detailed diary of her travels.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Then action, adjective+noun, of-phrase.
quests.explanation: 'Keeps a diary'=writes in it regularly.

quests.correctAnswer: We practise speaking English with our classmates.
quests.hint: Begin with 'We'. Then practice phrase, with whom.
quests.explanation: 'Practise speaking'=practise+gerund.

quests.correctAnswer: The postman delivers letters six days a week.
quests.hint: Start with 'The postman'. Then action, object, frequency.
quests.explanation: 'Six days a week' - compare: 'three times a day'.

quests.correctAnswer: She volunteers at a local animal shelter.
quests.hint: Begin with 'She'. Then action, where.
quests.explanation: 'Volunteers at' - 'volunteer' as verb=do unpaid helpful work.

quests.correctAnswer: He drinks plenty of water throughout the day.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. Then action, quantity, time.
quests.explanation: 'Plenty of water'=a large amount. 'Throughout the day'=continuously.

quests.correctAnswer: The gym opens early on weekday mornings.
quests.hint: Begin with 'The gym'. Then action, how, when.
quests.explanation: 'Early'=adverb. 'On weekday mornings'='on'+plural time.

quests.correctAnswer: She organises community events in her neighbourhood.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Then action, object, where.
quests.explanation: 'Community events'=activities for people in an area.

quests.correctAnswer: My parents enjoy cooking traditional family recipes.
quests.hint: Begin with 'My parents'. Then action, what.
quests.explanation: 'Enjoy+-ing' - after 'enjoy', use the gerund form.

quests.correctAnswer: The young couple saves money for a house.
quests.hint: Start with 'The young couple'. Then action, for what.
quests.explanation: 'Young couple'=adjective before noun. 'For' shows the goal.

quests.correctAnswer: She reads the news every morning with breakfast.
quests.hint: Begin with 'She'. Then action, time, with what.
quests.explanation: 'With breakfast'=while eating breakfast.

quests.correctAnswer: The park looks beautiful in autumn colours.
quests.hint: Start with 'The park'. Then linking verb, description, when.
quests.explanation: 'Looks' is a linking verb. After linking verbs, use adjectives.

quests.correctAnswer: She prepares her lessons the night before.
quests.hint: Begin with 'She'. Then action, object, when.
quests.explanation: 'The night before'=on the previous evening.

quests.correctAnswer: He volunteers to help elderly people every weekend.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. Then action+infinitive, time.
quests.explanation: 'Volunteers to help'=offers to do something.

quests.correctAnswer: My colleague brings homemade cakes to the office.
quests.hint: Begin with 'My colleague'. Then action, object, where.
quests.explanation: 'Homemade cakes'=made at home. 'Brings to'=carries to a place.

quests.correctAnswer: The restaurant serves breakfast until eleven o'clock.
quests.hint: Start with 'The restaurant'. Then action, object, until when.
quests.explanation: 'Until eleven o'clock'=up to that time.

quests.correctAnswer: She walks to the corner shop for groceries.
quests.hint: Begin with 'She'. Then action, where, purpose.
quests.explanation: 'For groceries'=in order to buy them.

quests.correctAnswer: He practises guitar for thirty minutes each evening.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. Then action, duration, when.
quests.explanation: 'For thirty minutes' - 'for'+duration shows how long.

quests.correctAnswer: The cafe offers free wifi to all customers.
quests.hint: Begin with 'The cafe'. Then action, object, to whom.
quests.explanation: 'Free wifi'=without cost. 'To all customers' shows who benefits.

quests.correctAnswer: She photographs flowers in parks and gardens.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Then action, object, two places.
quests.explanation: 'Parks and gardens' - 'and' joins two similar places.

quests.correctAnswer: My friend rents a flat near the university.
quests.hint: Begin with 'My friend'. Then action, object, where.
quests.explanation: 'Rents a flat'=pays to use the accommodation.

quests.correctAnswer: The supermarket reduces prices on selected items.
quests.hint: Start with 'The supermarket'. Then action, object, on what.
quests.explanation: 'Reduces prices on'=applies price cuts to selected products.

quests.correctAnswer: She commutes to work by underground train.
quests.hint: Begin with 'She'. Then travel verb, destination, method.
quests.explanation: 'Commutes'=travels regularly between home and work.

quests.correctAnswer: He writes a shopping list before visiting the supermarket.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. Then the action and object. Then before+gerund.
quests.explanation: 'Shopping list'=compound noun. 'Before visiting'='before'+gerund.

quests.correctAnswer: The bookshop displays new arrivals near the entrance.
quests.hint: Begin with 'The bookshop'. Then action, object, where.
quests.explanation: 'New arrivals'=recently received books.

quests.correctAnswer: She packs a healthy lunch for work every day.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Then action, adjective+noun, purpose, time.
quests.explanation: 'For work'=to take to work. 'Healthy lunch'=adjective before noun.

quests.correctAnswer: My parents moved to a smaller house last year.
quests.hint: Begin with 'My parents'. Then action, where, when.
quests.explanation: 'Moved to'=changed location to. 'Smaller house'=comparative adjective.
